summary: Tested trust badge system for 4Luis crowdfunding platform - 3 trust levels (sonhador, verificado, embaixador). All 7 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working correctly.

issues: React hydration warning: <tr> cannot be a child of <span>. This is a minor HTML structure issue in the users table but doesn't affect functionality.

Backend: Journey ambassador_info.level matches user's actual level in DB
Frontend: Trust badge (data-testid='trust-badge') found with 'Sonhador 4Luis' text
Frontend: Dreamer info section (data-testid='dreamer-info-section') shows 'Sonho de Manuel'
Frontend: Member since (data-testid='member-since') shows 'Membro da 4Luis desde 09/03/2026'

Backend endpoint PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/level (server.py:3823-3847) validates levels: sonhador, verificado, embaixador

Admin level dropdown (Admin.js:2328-2337) has correct options matching backend validation
Report problem button uses mailto link with pre-filled subject and body
